title: Error reduction for randomized polynomial time
statement: For all natural numbers $c,d$, every language having a polynomial-time randomized decider whose probability of producing the correct answer on inputs of length $n$ is at least $1/2+\min\{1/6,(n+1)^{-c}\}$ also has a polynomial-time randomized decider whose probability of producing the correct answer on inputs of length $n$ is at least $1-(1/2)^{(n+1)^d+1}$.
